track: multitq_kpct / guided reasoner (G_k, GU_k, SHUF_G1, QONLY_G1); stage B

rule.sha256_method: rule sha256_recipe: SHA-256 of json.dumps({all keys except sha256}, indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=str); equals the rule's own sha256 field

follows.B2: 4ee79238 (GPU-hour cap decision: cap 52 GPU-h, G_0 restored; fallbacks 1 and 2 in force)

type: implementation details of the guided-reasoner arms (selection_discipline, last bullet); no criterion, threshold, arm, comparator, subset, stratum or statistic changed
state_at_amendment: No G_k / GU_k adapter trained, no dev_sel2000 or test score of any guided arm. Structural bundles inspected for schema only (one train row, 300 train / test rows and the dev_sel2000 files of k01_s0 and k100, no answers of dev/test).

changes.bundle_source: Instruction (stage B): the structural track's bundles at WORK_DIR/bundles/<k>/ are used for EVERY k including k100, so operator trace and schema come from one code base. The guided-track conversion of the frozen k100 exports (B1) is used only as a cross-check (gk_crosscheck_k100.py).
changes.schema_mapping: normalize_bundle maps the structural kpct-parse-v1 schema: candidates {answer, rule_rank (1-based), s_score, s_rank (1-based), operator_satisfied, support_fact_idx (0-based into facts)}; facts {fid, head, relation, tail, date}; rule ranks converted to 0-based internally and rendered +1, so the prompt shows the same 1-based RULE rank as in B1. support_fids (KG line ids), gold_meta, in_sample_parse, template_unseen, pool_size and n_operator_satisfied are never shown to the model.
changes.parse_rendering: render_parse reads mentions[].alternatives[{entity}] (first = linked entity, up to 2 alternatives), relations[0] (highest-probability relation-direction hypothesis), qtype / answer_type / granularity labels (probabilities not shown), operator_keywords as 'keyword: ...', time.value. The structural parse has no anchor field, so no anchor line is printed (B1 printed 'anchor: none'). G_HEAD, GU_HEAD, candidate, fact and trace layout are unchanged.
changes.stop_oof_leak: producers.json is not staged; the check uses each train row's oof field {outer_fold f, stack_trained_on '<k>/fold<1-f>'} and the registered outer folds of multitq_kpct_subsets.json (fold sha256 checked, folds partition the k% list): every train quid must lie in its own fold f and not in fold 1-f, the training fold of its producer. k100: reader_train60k disjoint from s_train100k (frozen exports: classifier OOF, S on s_train100k, linker in-sample, disclosed).
changes.inference_shards: gk_run_arm.py generates in shards of 5,000 prompts cached on disk with the adapter sha256 (STOP_HOST: 'inference in shards'); a restarted session reuses finished shards
changes.train_resume: gk_train.py exits without retraining when the final checkpoint and train_stats.json exist; otherwise resumes from ckpt.pt (every 500 steps)
changes.selection_log: every dev_sel2000 Hits@1 of a guided checkpoint is appended as computed to WORK_DIR/guided/multitq_kpct_guided_selection_log.jsonl (for the analysts' multitq_kpct_selection_log.json)
changes.gpu: card 0 only until the analysts releases card 1; one process per card; GPU usage log rows track 'guided'
